_comment: T-349 Syndicate street tier, WAVE 1 — the occult TELL on the street (bridge to the S5 Gull Cellars dungeon). A HUMAN on the T-118 hero rig (entity_visuals maps mob_seance_warden -> char_hero_mage.glb, robe silhouette, dark tint + a sickly rift-green sigil accent on the trim). Reads as a caster via the mage rig + existing cast clips; mechanically a melee-range attacker on the shared mob swing path (the engine has no ranged/caster mob attack until T-350's keep-distance work — the restless-shade precedent: int-flavoured but melee). Squishiest of the wave-1 three, highest dodge, occult loot. L20-24 band.
